item.title: Back Side of ID Card: What to Write, With Ready-to-Copy Text
item.description: What to put on the back side of an ID card: six blocks in priority order, ready-to-copy English and Bangla text for each card type, and a to-scale layout.

item.title: How to Take an ID Card Photo on Your Phone: Setup and Size
item.description: How to take an ID card photo with a phone: plain background, window light, the right distance and framing, exact crop sizes in mm and pixels, and a photo-day plan.

item.title: School ID Card Design: Student Fields, Layout and Renewal
item.description: School ID card design for schools and madrasas: exact student fields for front and back, what to keep off for child safety, sizes and a yearly renewal plan.

item.title: Employee ID Card Design: What to Include, Front and Back
item.description: Employee ID card design made simple: which fields go on the front and back, what never to print, font sizes in pt and a layout for every company size.

item.title: How to Make ID Cards on Mobile: The Complete Phone Workflow
item.description: How to make ID cards on mobile from start to finish: plan the fields, collect data and photos, pick a template, check every card and print A4 sheets at 300 DPI.

item.title: ID Card Size in Pixels, mm and Inches (CR80 and Every Badge Size)
item.description: The exact ID card size in pixels at 300 and 600 DPI, plus CR80, CR79 and CR100 in mm and inches, bleed, safe zone, thickness and badge sizes in one table.

item.title: How to Print ID Cards on A4 Paper (Layouts, Settings and Cutting)
item.description: Exactly how many CR80 ID cards fit on an A4 sheet, the margins and gaps that work, the print settings that keep cards true to size, and how to line up the backs for double-sided printing.
